name: SchemeSetu
tagline: Every rural family, matched to the welfare schemes they deserve
problem: Rural families miss crop insurance, pensions, housing, scholarships
Eligibility rules are complex, scattered and mostly online
Offices are far away; middlemen charge fees to find and fill schemes
Field workers can't see which eligible families haven't applied

stats.label: farm holdings small / marginal (Agri Census 2015-16, approx.)
fields to check our 22 schemes one by one (measured)

solution: Adaptive Tamil / English questionnaire with big buttons
Explainable rules: eligible / possibly / not, per condition
One deduplicated document checklist + application tracker

features.title: Explainable eligibility
features.desc: JSON rule trees with 3-valued logic; pass / fail / unknown per condition

features.title: Smart questionnaire
features.desc: Greedy information gain: 15 questions vs a 22-field form, same decisions

features.title: Benefit estimator
features.desc: Adds fixed ₹ amounts only; insurance cover and loans shown separately

features.title: Document checklist
features.desc: Union of required documents, deduplicated, printable, tracked

features.title: Bilingual search
features.desc: TF-IDF + concept map: 'பயிர் காப்பீடு' finds crop insurance

features.title: Field-worker mode
features.desc: Register households; see unclaimed benefits per scheme and family

architecture: Browser UI (vanilla JS, EN/TA, SVG) -> JSON API
rules.py -> 3-valued rule engine with full trace
algorithms: Kleene 3-valued logic – eligible / possibly / not, with reasons
Expected information gain – picks the next best question
TF-IDF + bilingual concept map – Tamil / English search
innovation: Says 'possibly eligible – need X' instead of silently rejecting
Explains why each question is asked (bits of information)
Rules are data: officers edit JSON, not code
Offline last-mile tool with a village unclaimed-benefit view

results.label: decisions identical to the full form

demo_flow: Open 'Why?' on PM-KISAN to show the condition tree
Answer live; tap 'Don't know' -> possibly eligible
Print the checklist; mark an application Applied
Field worker: village dashboard of unclaimed benefits
impact: Entitlements found in ~5 minutes, in Tamil, no middleman
Demo village: ₹1.57 lakh/yr unclaimed cash surfaced (synthetic)
Widows, elderly and women heads of family surfaced explicitly
business: Deployment for CSCs, Panchayats and SHG federations
CSR / NGO programmes measuring benefit uptake
Offline companion for state welfare departments
future: Sync field-worker devices to a block server
Offline Tamil voice input for low-literacy users
Import official scheme data; per-district rules
OCR of ration card / patta to pre-fill answers
SMS reminders for deadlines such as PMFBY cut-offs
